newsitem.title: USA: Western Investment chief executive to retire.
newsitem.headline: Western Investment chief executive to retire.

text.p: Western Investment Real Estate Trust said Tuesday its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Bill Talmage plans to resign as chief executive.
The company said it is seeking a successor.

"It has been a privilege to have been a part of Western's founding, to have served as a Trustee since 1962 and as the chief executive since 1982, and to have had a part in Western's achievements and growth during the company's 35-year history," Talmage said.
Talmage said he will remain in his position until a successor is found.
